answer: Every identity posts a bonded deposit of 5,000 POA before grading, recorded on-ledger with a lotus slash trail linking each grade to its author. When grades diverge from consensus by over 15%, the chain slashes 20% of the bond, costing a dishonest grader roughly $180 per bad grade. One honest agent risks one deposit and grades carefully; ten fakes must lock ten deposits and lose ten times the stake when their pearl grades disagree with the majority. Repeat divergence freezes the identity, and slashed funds flow back to honest sparrow graders.
